answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}x^3-5x^2-x+14&=0\\5x^2-x^3-4&=10-x\end{aligned}$

Draw $y=10-x$ on the grid from part b. Read the $x$-coordinates of its intersections with the cubic:

$x\approx-1.5,\ 2,\ 4.5$.
